# Voice instructions

Follow `docs/VOICE_SYSTEM.md`, `docs/PROMPT_ENGINEERING.md`, `docs/EVALS.md`.
Keep responses short. Barge-in must stop synthesis quickly. Confirm high-impact fields before mutations. Never invent business/account/medical facts. Offer handoff when needed. Normalize provider events and treat webhooks as untrusted.
